report.summary: The report is well-sourced overall. All checkable claims are supported by the cited DRHP pages, except one sentence where the source confirms the core business (processing and selling specialty chemicals) but does not explicitly mention the specific end-use applications listed. This is a minor partial issue. No unsupported or wrong-source claims were found. The report accurately reflects the DRHP's disclosures.
